title: Last long run 2h25 / ~1050m D+, 3 race-effort climbs
terrain: Hilly trail, ~1050m D+, climbs of 12min+ with runnable descents

steps.target: Z2-Z3, 140-160bpm, descent at race effort, 172+ spm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 20m easy, 60min at 145-155bpm (HARD cap 155, hike climbs), then 3x(12min climb at 162-170bpm + 8min descent at race effort, 172+ spm), 5m easy.
GYM: none.
FUEL: full race rehearsal: race breakfast, Tailwind from min 20, gels at 1h00 and 1h45 (~75g/h), race shoes and vest.
GARMIN: ~240-270.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or RHR 52+ = 2 climbs, cap 1h50.
WHY: last long stimulus 7 days out. Sun 25 had 77min in Z3-Z4 vs ~30 planned: the Z2 cap is the session.
